description: Diplomatic transcription of the title page of Le loisir philosophique, line by line, with the scan. Small capitals as capitals. Line styles: xl large capitals, caps spaced capitals, icaps italic spaced capitals, it italic, device a description of the printer's device, rule an ornamental rule. The page is printed in red and black. Read from the scan; checked against it by eye.

source: Google Books scan of the BCU Lausanne copy, PDF p. 7
lines: A crowned shield between two laurel branches.
